value.text: {"sql": "SELECT local_day, usgs_peak_cfs, usgs_peak_hour_cdt, nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_hour_cdt, lag_hours, peak_error_cfs FROM (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS hr_cdt, usgs_northport_peak_cfs AS usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_cfs AS nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_hour_cdt, (nwm_peak_hour_cdt - usgs_peak_hour_cdt) AS lag_hours, (nwm_peak_cfs - usgs_peak_cfs) AS peak_error_cfs FROM (SELECT hr_utc, usgs_northport_peak_cfs, nwm_cfs, to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS hr_cdt FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc >= '2026-10-23 05:00' AND hr_utc < '2026-10-25 05:00' AND usgs_northport_peak_cfs IS NOT NULL AND nwm_cfs IS NOT NULL) t CROSS JOIN (SELECT hr_utc, MAX(nwm_cfs) AS nwm_peak_cfs, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS nwm_peak_hour_cdt FROM (SELECT hr_utc, nwm_cfs, to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS hr_cdt FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc >= '2026-10-23 05:00' AND hr_utc < '2026-10-25 05:00' AND nwm_cfs IS NOT NULL) t2 GROUP BY hr_utc) s ON t.hr_utc = s.hr_utc GROUP BY local_day HAVING MAX(usgs_peak_cfs) > 1000) d ORDER BY local_day", "purpose": "Quantify NWM performance on Oct 23–24 by comparing NWM peak flow, timing lag relative to USGS 15-min peak, and magnitude error at USGS peak hour and NWM peak hour"}
